author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream game launches April 16, 2026, on the Nintendo Switch system. Pre-orders and a free demo are available now on Nintendo eShop: https://ninten.do/6003QCRP5 

Welcome back to Yoomian Island! Everyone, say hello to Tara! She’s a senior at Angie’s college and she’s just SO cool! Like…cooler than cool, if that even exists!  

Become the caretaker of an island full of silliness, drama, love, and other surprises in Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream.
This game is also compatible with the Nintendo Switch 2 system.

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
